Jesus... my younger cousin drove to the family lunch in his new car. I said I prefer the metro. 🚗

Bible verse for comparison, when family compares you.

At the family lunch his younger cousin showed off a new car, and he stayed inside pretending he prefers the metro.

Jesus: “Your life isn't late. It's yours. I never measured anyone by their keys.”

“Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.””
Hebrews 13:5 (BSB)

Next time, go out. Be glad for him, at peace with you.

youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Bible verse for comparison, when family compares you.

He: Jesus... my younger cousin drove to the family lunch in his new car. I said I prefer the metro. 🚗
He: Everyone went out to see it. I kept eating.
Jesus: You weren't hungry. You didn't want them to see your face.
He: He's twenty-four. I'm thirty and still saving for a scooter.
Jesus: Your life isn't late. It's yours. I never measured anyone by their keys.
Jesus: Next time, go out. Be glad for him, at peace with you.

“Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.””
Hebrews 13:5 (BSB)
